verdict.rationale: Puzzle markets an 'API-powered' Embedded Accounting product and has help docs for setting up a Puzzle MCP integration, suggesting some programmatic/agentic access exists, but there is no evidence of actual public API documentation (OpenAPI/swagger probes all 404) or concrete usage examples for AI-native drivers. missing for 10: publicly accessible API reference/OpenAPI spec, example API calls or SDKs, and independent confirmation the API/MCP is usable by end developers rather than embedded partners only.
